tips.text: Skip building a K-Drive to start; the loaner Bondi board is on the gear wheel, not in the Arsenal.
Get a moddable board with a few Ventkids ranks before page 3; the stock Bondi cannot take mods.
Slot Air Time, Primo Flair, Inertia Dampeners, Mag Locks, Perfect Balance and Pop Top on the board.
Archwing high up, dismount with melee, then summon the K-Drive mid-air for the airtime and long-chain feats.
Bind the K-Drive to a gear hotkey before the archwing drop; fumbling the gear wheel wastes it.
Grind the Pearl's circular rim to stack a combo without ever reaching an end.
On the pipe behind Fortuna's entrance, grind to the end, charge-jump, rotate, and land back on it.
Hold grind on the coolant tower roots and spam jump; it needs no precision.
Pick a long open race and just finish it; the gates alone cover the race-point feats.
Stand on a K-Drive to see races on the map; they are hidden otherwise, and on Merulina.
Press the swap-weapon key while riding to bring out your secondary for the kill feats.
For slam kills, jump, tap crouch, then hold crouch until landing, and fight unshielded Grineer or Infested.
Charge the jump instead of tapping it for more height and a longer combo window.
Cash out or keep moving; the combo meter expires on its own, not only when you wipe out.
Vary your tricks; repeating one more than three times stops advancing a chain.
Attempt the trick feats in ten-minute sittings over several days instead of one long grind.
Don't plan on Yareli Prime's Merulina for the quest; players disagree on which feats it tracks.
Confirm a clan has built the Ventkids' Bash Lab before joining; many dojos never did.
Start the Bash Lab research as soon as you are in the clan; it runs while you do the quest.
Players report one to two hours for the quest once comfortable with the board, but days for the standing grind.
Expect tedium, not difficulty; many veteran players still bounce off the trick feats.
